questions.q: Why does a multirotor need a compass for POSHOLD?
options: For altitude and showing heading in the OSD
To convert position error into tilt
questions.explain: Without heading the controller can't convert position error into tilt.

options: Climb to no lower than nav_rth_altitude
Return at the current altitude without climbing
questions.explain: The return is never lower than the set altitude.

questions.q: What does INAV do if GPS is lost during RTH?
options: Continues the return from the remembered heading
Safehome for missions and manual RTH
questions.explain: On manual RTH, home is used.

options: The stick sets the tilt, GPS holds position
questions.explain: In CRUISE the stick sets the speed; in ATTI, the tilt.
Climb to the RTH altitude first, then turn home — mandatory for forests; ON_FW_SPIRAL is a spiral climb for wings.

options: The distance to home is growing
The battery is low and altitude is low
questions.explain: The distance to home grows during RTH — a sign of a wrong home point or compass; RTH is aborted into an emergency landing.
